Former wall map showing buildings and householders' names in rural areas. Does not show property lines.

Former wall map showing buildings and householders' names in rural areas. Does not show property lines. Relief shown by hachures and spot heights. "Entered according to Act of Congress by G.A. Aschbach in the year 1862 in ... the eastern District of Pennsylvania." Hand col. to emphasize minor civil divisions (townships and boroughs). Printed in northern/southern segments (sheets). LC copy imperfect: Laminated, darkened, mounted on cloth backing, original sheets sectioned into numerous panels to enable folding. Includes text (historical), notes, statistical table, distance table, 23 village/town insets (including Allentown and Bethlehem), ill. of buildings, low-angle views of towns/industries, and advertisements.
